cs.t: I recently bought an LG Classic Flip. The phone itself was $30, plus about another $30 to start the prepaid plan through Tracfone. I use it for testing phone routing at work. When I got it, the guy at the store said that prepaid isn't the same as it used to be before smartphones were everywhere. Instead of paying for X number of minutes that carry over, you get X minutes for Y days. Luckily, though, it's still pretty cheap. I just refilled for 90 days of unlimited phone calls for about $20.
